title: Beneath a Crimson Sky
request: so can we rebuild the original artwork, at 4k and ensure AAA levels of realism and detail?
scope: New clean still; preserve composition and scene identity while rebuilding material and construction detail. Original assets and animation stay preserved.
inspection_checks: Quiet stone faces with real joints, no embossed loops
Broad coherent rock strata and fractures, no melted lattice
Continuous supported architecture and clean windows
Separate wood, cloth, iron and stone responses
Chosen camera, fortress silhouette, props and ruins retained
Larger rocky world in luminous clear opening, no cloud crossing or halo
Material detail resolves at native size without sharpening artifacts

iterations.inspection: Broad cliff masses and bridge/arch construction improved; foreground stone retains conspicuous etched/embossed patterns. Internal candidate requiring focused material correction.
Focused correction retained the embossed terrace-stone pattern. Rejected as a material-quality fix; preserved internally.

iterations.input_role: Original clean terrace only; degraded v11/v12 pixels omitted

successes: Broader coherent cliff strata and natural fracture planes replace the melted lattice of v11
Foreground stone has quieter faces and more credible block/joint construction
Bridge arches and principal monastery masses read as supported construction
Original bench, blanket, barrel, lantern, roof framing and sheltered terrace remain
Rocky world is unobscured within a luminous clear red-orange opening
limitations: Fresh reconstruction changes the detailed fortress design, dome placement and some terrain contours; not pixel-preserved v7/v11 geometry
World appears a little higher and slightly smaller than v11, while retaining the requested larger-than-original scale
Some foreground tooling/roughness remains; AAA is an art-direction target, not a verified production certification
Generated image is 1672x941; the 3840x2160 file is upscaled and contains no extra detail from resampling

current_work: Complete for this still-generation request; new candidate requires user review. Existing animation remains bound to v11.

latest_user_feedback.quote: yeah i think it looks alot better do you?
latest_user_feedback.scope: Positive comparison of v12 image quality with prior artwork; no new rendering, final-master approval or animation remapping requested.
